description: This file contains a Roslyn analyzer class 'AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzer' that enforces usage rules for the 'AlwaysInterleave' attribute in Orleans grain interfaces and classes. It registers syntax node actions to analyze method declarations and reports diagnostics if the attribute is misused.

classes.name: AlwaysInterleaveDiagnosticAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer class that checks for correct usage of the 'AlwaysInterleave' attribute in Orleans grain code.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the analysis context, configuring code analysis and registering syntax node actions for method declarations.

methods.name: AnalyzeSyntax
methods.description: Analyzes method declaration syntax nodes to verify if the 'AlwaysInterleave' attribute is correctly applied, and reports diagnostics if misused.
